summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (last Graph method, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested add_to_cbd helper implementing the three W3C CBD rules, including untyped reification. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering rule 1/2 counts (8, 3, 2, 0), reified cases A (8) and B (13), incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node reifier non-expansion, blank-node cycle termination, and source immutability. Nothing was run or committed, so the tests are unverified; expected counts were checked by hand against the fixture.
